clusters.headline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in country’s history
clusters.summary: A top UN official says 'speed, scale, and solidarity' needed 'before this virus gets even further ahead of us'.

clusters.headline: Jason Arday: Ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism scandal found dead
clusters.summary: Jason Arday, the youngest ever Black professor at Cambridge, was found unresponsive at an address in London. Arday had recently resigned in the midst of a plagiarism row.

clusters.headline: American actress Hayden Panettiere dies at 36: Report
clusters.summary: Panettiere was known for her roles in TV shows such as Nashville and Heroes.

clusters.headline: Zimbabwe: Kariba Boat Disaster - Rising Death Toll Exposes Rida 'Lies', Passenger Figures Under Scrutiny As Body Count Hits 84
clusters.summary: [New Zimbabwe] THE number of people aboard the ill-fated Rural Infrastructure Development Agency (RIDA) boat on Lake Kariba appears to have been higher than the 153 passengers previously indicated, with the latest death toll and rescue figures accounting for at least 161 people.

clusters.headline: West Africa: Lithium in the Sahel - How Armed Groups Are Exploiting the Global Scramble for the Critical Mineral
clusters.summary: [The Conversation Africa] Every electric vehicle, smartphone and laptop battery begins with one essential ingredient: lithium.

clusters.headline: Zimbabwe: 'Stay in That Lane and Know That the More You Give, the More You Receive', Says Mnangagwa to Chivayo
clusters.summary: [New Zimbabwe] PRESIDENT Emmerson Mnangagwa has showered praise on controversial tycoon Wicknell Chivayo, saluting him for his "philanthropy."

clusters.headline: MUIS to strengthen patrols, CCTV monitoring after 'serious sexual offences' involving young victim at mosque
clusters.summary: A MUIS spokesperson stressed that the offender in the case is not a mosque staff member or volunteer, nor is he an accredited religious teacher.

clusters.headline: South Africa: Marikana Massacre 14 Years On - Victims' Families Still Await Criminal Accountability
clusters.summary: [Daily Maverick] More than a decade after 34 mineworkers were gunned down by police, their families are still fighting for justice and trade unions for better working conditions.

clusters.headline: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
clusters.summary: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones across Russia Sunday, killing at least six people in one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.

clusters.headline: Founding Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew's Montblanc pen sold for S$461,500 at auction after 111 bids
